description: Angular component for configuring progress bar widget settings in the Thingsboard platform, including form setup, validation, and preview functionality.

classes.name: ProgressBarWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for managing progress bar widget settings, including form controls, validation, and preview.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget settings.

methods.name: onSettingsSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided widget settings.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form controls that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current settings and updates validity.

methods.name: _valuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a preview string for the widget value, using current configuration.
